# Casio fx-580VN X integration

Source: https://github.com/Tikz-Physics/casio-fx580vnx

Pinned commit: `b180a74e8a900b56f73914e74d98956605e75142`.

`upstream/` contains every tracked file from that commit, unchanged, including the original HTML, bundled ZIP, launchers, fonts, icons and documentation. `UPSTREAM.json` records their SHA-256 hashes. No upstream launcher is executed by the notebook.

`runtime.html` is generated by `scripts/build-casio.cjs`. The original calculator JavaScript is byte-for-byte unchanged. The build embeds local font references, adds an offline Content Security Policy and appends a separate host bridge. `BUILD.json` records the calculator-script hash and runtime hash.

The bridge connects result/LCD insertion and window sizing to the notebook, and replaces the network update action with offline build information. The calculator runs in a sandboxed iframe with an opaque origin. In-frame clipboard operations use the host's clipboard/PNG fallback; LCD images still use the upstream renderer.

The upstream repository snapshot has no root LICENSE file. Its code/artwork are attributed to their upstream authors; this integration does not relicense them as MIT or claim to be an official Casio product. The original font license is preserved at `upstream/fonts/OFL.txt` (SIL Open Font License 1.1). Font files are embedded unchanged, without changing their names or glyphs.
